verdict.rationale: Missive's MCP integration lets external AI (Claude, ChatGPT) draft replies and even send them via the hosted MCP server (drafts:write/drafts:deliver scopes confirmed live), and docs explicitly mention asking Claude to 'draft replies without leaving the chat.' However, there is no evidence the AI is tuned to the user's own voice/tone rather than generic drafting — Missive's own templating feature (canned responses) is explicitly boilerplate-style, and no docs claim personalized style-matching for AI drafts. Missing for 10: explicit voice/tone personalization mechanism, evidence of learning from user's writing style, hands-on confirmation that drafts read as user's own voice rather than generic AI output.
